capabilities: Create or open today's daily report from a sidebar view
Collect Markdown tasks from daily reports and group them by planned date
Separate unfinished, long-unfinished, and overdue tasks
Complete tasks from the sidebar and write completion timestamps back to notes
Configure report folder, filename pattern, and template
disambiguation: Not a general task manager; it organizes tasks found in daily-report notes and one future-tasks file.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README is bilingual (English and Simplified Chinese) and states the plugin makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian tracks tasks inside notes but offers no dedicated view for grouping unfinished, overdue, and future tasks that live across daily reports.
summary: Right-sidebar view that creates daily work reports and organizes tasks from them by planned date, unfinished, overdue, and future status.
